authoredFrom: Erlang semantics: arity is part of function identity; -export([pick/0, pick/1]) is a legal export list naming two distinct functions. Authored from the language contract and the pinned grammar's fun_decl/function_clause/expr_args shapes (probed 2026-09-17), before observing this fixture's F3 run. ER-D43 (2026-10-03): the edge rows below were added when the corpus draw found that a same-line multi-arity export list published one row instead of two.

expectRelationships.note: ER-D43: an `exports` edge publishes the module's INTERFACE, and the interface is keyed by `name/arity`. Before this row existed nothing pinned the EDGES of this fixture — `expectExports` reads the `ExportInfo` array, which recorded both identities, so the fixture passed while the relationship published only `pick/0`. The dedupe key carried `line`, and both publications sit on line 2, so the second was dropped: the module's public surface was published at half its real size with no error and no counter. Measured 340 sites in a 204-file corpus draw (`otp/lib/asn1/examples/test_driver.erl:10` publishes four identities on ONE line, two of them under the same name at arities 0 and 1). Two identities, one name, two rows.
the second identity, same target and same line as the first

the SECOND identity's name line. `pick/1` spans clauses 5 and 6 (`pick(0) -> zero;` / `pick(X) -> X.`) and `contains` is named at the last clause head, which is the same rule ER-D33 records for a declaration split across lines.
